# Vendored references (pinned, read-only)

Selected files from the two reference projects whose checklists Orkestra still uses.
Nothing in this folder is loaded at runtime. Each folder keeps its upstream LICENSE
(copyright lines and notes: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`). Refresh with `install.sh --refresh-vendor`.

| folder | upstream | commit | date | license | used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| superpowers | https://github.com/obra/superpowers | 8ca22db | 2026-09-25 | MIT | subagent loop, TDD + verification discipline, debugging |
| ecc | https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC | ef648e0 | 2026-10-01 | MIT | security / stack / data / ui-flow review checklists |
